title: Time & Days
description: Say when - and make plans that stick.

questions.sentence: Aaje kayo var che?
options: Aaje budhvar che.
Aaje pandar tarikh che.
Atyare nav vagya che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aaje budhvar che.
questions.translatedSentence: Today is Wednesday.

questions.sentence: Somvare mane kaam che.
options: I have work on Monday.
I have work on Sunday.
I have work every day.
questions.correctAnswer: I have work on Monday.

questions.sentence: Shanivare tame kya jaao cho?
options: Shanivare hu bajar jau chu.
Shanivare hu vahelo uthu chu.
Shanivare mane bhukh lage che.
questions.correctAnswer: Shanivare hu bajar jau chu.
questions.translatedSentence: On Saturday I go to the market.

questions.sentence: Ravivare hu ghare aaram karu chu.
options: On Sunday I rest at home.
On Sunday I work at home.
On Monday I rest at home.
questions.correctAnswer: On Sunday I rest at home.

questions.sentence: Guruvar pachhi kayo var aave?
options: Shukravar aave che.
Budhvar aave che.
Mangalvar aave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Shukravar aave che.
questions.translatedSentence: Friday comes next.

questions.sentence: Mangalvare maro Gujarati class che.
options: My Gujarati class is on Tuesday.
My Gujarati class is on Thursday.
My Gujarati class was on Tuesday.
questions.correctAnswer: My Gujarati class is on Tuesday.

questions.sentence: Tamne kayo var game che?
options: Mane shukravar game che.
Mane chaas bahu game che.
Mane aa jagya game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane shukravar game che.
questions.translatedSentence: I like Friday.

questions.sentence: Athvadiya ma saat divas hoy che.
options: There are seven days in a week.
There are seven weeks in a month.
There are seven hours in a day.
questions.correctAnswer: There are seven days in a week.

questions.sentence: Budhvare tame free cho?
options: Ha, budhvare hu free chu.
Ha, budhvar pachhi guruvar aave che.
Na, mane aa var ni khabar nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, budhvare hu free chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am free on Wednesday.

questions.sentence: Tame gai kaale kya hata?
options: Hu gai kaale Surat ma hato.
Hu kaale Surat javano chu.
Hu atyare ghare j chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu gai kaale Surat ma hato.
questions.translatedSentence: Yesterday I was in Surat.

questions.sentence: Hu kaale Ahmedabad javano chu.
options: I am going to Ahmedabad tomorrow.
I went to Ahmedabad yesterday.
I am in Ahmedabad right now.
questions.correctAnswer: I am going to Ahmedabad tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Atyare tame shu karo cho?
options: Atyare hu jamu chu.
Gai kaale hu jamyo hato.
Kaale hu tamari sathe jamis.
questions.correctAnswer: Atyare hu jamu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Right now I am eating.

questions.sentence: Gai kaale bahu varsad padyo hato.
options: It rained a lot yesterday.
It is raining a lot today.
It will rain a lot tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: It rained a lot yesterday.

questions.sentence: Aapne atyare nikaliye?
options: Na, thodi vaar pachhi nikaliye.
Ha, aapne gai kaale nikalya hata.
Na, aa rasto bahu lambo che.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, thodi vaar pachhi nikaliye.
questions.translatedSentence: No, let us leave a little later.

questions.sentence: Aa kaam hu pachhi karis, atyare nahi.
options: I will do this work later, not now.
I will do this work now, not later.
I did this work yesterday, not today.
questions.correctAnswer: I will do this work later, not now.

questions.sentence: Tame aaje thepla kyare banavya?
options: Me aaje savare banavya.
Me gai kaale raate banavya hata.
Hu kaale sudhi ma banavis.
questions.correctAnswer: Me aaje savare banavya.
questions.translatedSentence: I made them this morning.

questions.sentence: Gai kaale sudhi mane aa vat ni khabar na hati.
options: Until yesterday I did not know about this.
Even now I do not know about this.
Until tomorrow I will not know about this.
questions.correctAnswer: Until yesterday I did not know about this.

questions.sentence: Kaale tamne samay male che?
options: Ha, kaale bapore mane samay che.
Ha, gai kaale mane samay hato.
Na, aaje maro janamdivas che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, kaale bapore mane samay che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have time tomorrow afternoon.

questions.sentence: Atyare ketla vagya che?
options: Atyare saade chaar vagya che.
Atyare mangalvar che.
Atyare mane bhukh lagi che.
questions.correctAnswer: Atyare saade chaar vagya che.
questions.translatedSentence: It is half past four right now.

questions.sentence: Train saade aath vagye upade che.
options: The train leaves at half past eight.
The train leaves at half past nine.
The train arrives at half past eight.
questions.correctAnswer: The train leaves at half past eight.

questions.sentence: Tame ketla vagye office pahoncho cho?
options: Hu das vagye office pahonchu chu.
Hu bus ma office jau chu.
Maru office ahiya thi najik che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu das vagye office pahonchu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I reach the office at ten.

questions.sentence: Sava nav vagya che, jaldi karo.
options: It is quarter past nine, hurry up.
It is quarter to nine, hurry up.
It is half past nine, hurry up.
questions.correctAnswer: It is quarter past nine, hurry up.

questions.sentence: Dukan ketla vagye khule che?
options: Dukan savare aath vagye khule che.
Dukan aa rasta na chede che.
Dukan ma dhokla bahu saras male che.
questions.correctAnswer: Dukan savare aath vagye khule che.
questions.translatedSentence: The shop opens at eight in the morning.

questions.sentence: Mane pona baar vagye phone karjo.
options: Please call me at quarter to twelve.
Please call me at quarter past twelve.
Please call me at twelve o'clock.
questions.correctAnswer: Please call me at quarter to twelve.

questions.sentence: Saanje paanch vagye tame shu karo cho?
options: Saanje paanch vagye hu chaa piu chu.
Mane saanje ni chaa bahu game che.
Hu chaa nathi pito, hu chaas piu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Saanje paanch vagye hu chaa piu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: At five in the evening I drink tea.

questions.sentence: Bapore ek vagye jamvano samay che.
options: Lunch is at one in the afternoon.
Lunch is at two in the afternoon.
Breakfast is at one in the afternoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Lunch is at one in the afternoon.

questions.sentence: Film ketla vagye shuru thay che?
options: Film raate nav vagye shuru thay che.
Film tran kalak chale che.
Film ni tickets me lai lidhi che.
questions.correctAnswer: Film raate nav vagye shuru thay che.
questions.translatedSentence: The film starts at nine at night.

questions.sentence: Tamaro janamdivas kya mahina ma aave che?
options: Maro janamdivas march ma aave che.
Maro janamdivas ravivare aave che.
Mane janamdivas ujavvo bahu game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Maro janamdivas march ma aave che.
questions.translatedSentence: My birthday is in March.

questions.sentence: Chomasa ma Gujarat ma khub varsad pade che.
options: It rains a lot in Gujarat during the monsoon.
It rains very little in Gujarat during the monsoon.
It rains a lot in Gujarat during the winter.
questions.correctAnswer: It rains a lot in Gujarat during the monsoon.

questions.sentence: Aaje ketli tarikh che?
options: Aaje vees tarikh che.
Aaje saade das vagya che.
Aaje somvar che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aaje vees tarikh che.
questions.translatedSentence: Today is the twentieth.

questions.sentence: Unaala ma Ahmedabad ma bahu garmi pade che.
options: It gets very hot in Ahmedabad in the summer.
It gets very cold in Ahmedabad in the summer.
It gets very hot in Ahmedabad in the winter.
questions.correctAnswer: It gets very hot in Ahmedabad in the summer.

questions.sentence: Uttarayan kyare aave che?
options: Uttarayan janyuari ma aave che.
Uttarayan patang thi ujavaay che.
Uttarayan par aakash bharai jaay che.
questions.correctAnswer: Uttarayan janyuari ma aave che.
questions.translatedSentence: Uttarayan falls in January.

questions.sentence: Shiyala ma savare bahu thandi lage che.
options: It feels very cold in the mornings in winter.
It feels very hot in the mornings in winter.
It feels very cold in the evenings in winter.
questions.correctAnswer: It feels very cold in the mornings in winter.

questions.sentence: Tame kya mahina ma Gir javana cho?
options: Hu disembar ma Gir javano chu.
Hu Gir ma singh jova javano chu.
Hu train ma Gir javano chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu disembar ma Gir javano chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to Gir in December.

questions.sentence: Loko undhiyu shiyala ma banave che.
options: People make undhiyu in the winter.
People make undhiyu in the summer.
People eat undhiyu in the winter.
questions.correctAnswer: People make undhiyu in the winter.

questions.sentence: Aa varshe Diwali kya mahina ma che?
options: Aa varshe Diwali oktober ma che.
Aa varshe Diwali ame ghare ujavishu.
Diwali pachhi navu varsh shuru thay che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aa varshe Diwali oktober ma che.
questions.translatedSentence: This year Diwali falls in October.

questions.sentence: Tame savare ketla vagye utho cho?
options: Hu savare saade chha vagye uthu chu.
Hu roj bahu vahelo uthu chu.
Hu uthi ne tarat chaa piu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu savare saade chha vagye uthu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I get up at half past six in the morning.

questions.sentence: Savar ma hu nasta ma thepla khau chu.
options: In the morning I eat thepla for breakfast.
In the evening I eat thepla for dinner.
In the morning I make thepla for breakfast.
questions.correctAnswer: In the morning I eat thepla for breakfast.

questions.sentence: Tame nasta ma shu lo cho?
options: Hu nasta ma dhokla lau chu.
Hu nasto nav vagye karu chu.
Nasto mari mummy banave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu nasta ma dhokla lau chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I have dhokla for breakfast.

questions.sentence: Hu roj bus ma kaam par jau chu.
options: I go to work by bus every day.
I go to work by train every day.
I went to work by bus today.
questions.correctAnswer: I go to work by bus every day.

questions.sentence: Bapore tame kya jamo cho?
options: Bapore hu office ni kantin ma jamu chu.
Bapore hu ek vagye jamu chu.
Bapore hu daal bhaat jamu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Bapore hu office ni kantin ma jamu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: At lunchtime I eat in the office canteen.

questions.sentence: Saanje hu ghare avi ne chaas piu chu.
options: In the evening I come home and drink chaas.
In the evening I go out and drink chaas.
In the morning I come home and drink chaas.
questions.correctAnswer: In the evening I come home and drink chaas.

questions.sentence: Tame raate ketla vagye sui jaao cho?
options: Hu raate agiyar vagye sui jau chu.
Hu raate bahu ochu sui shaku chu.
Hu sutaa pehla thodu vaanchu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu raate agiyar vagye sui jau chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I go to sleep at eleven at night.

questions.sentence: Ravivare hu vahelo nathi uthto.
options: I do not get up early on Sundays.
I do not go to sleep early on Sundays.
I get up early on Sundays.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not get up early on Sundays.

questions.sentence: Tu roj kasrat kyare kare che?
options: Hu roj savare chalva jau chu.
Hu ghar pase na bagicha ma jau chu.
Mane kasrat karvi bahu game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu roj savare chalva jau chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I go for a walk every morning.

questions.sentence: Shu aapne aa athvadiye male shakie?
options: Ha, jo tamne fave to guruvare maliye.
Ha, gai kaale ni mulakat bahu saras hati.
Na, mane aa jagya ni khabar nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, jo tamne fave to guruvare maliye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, if it suits you, let us meet on Thursday.

questions.sentence: Hu kaale nahi avi shaku kem ke mare kaam che.
options: I cannot come tomorrow because I have work.
I could not come yesterday because I had work.
I will come tomorrow even though I have work.
questions.correctAnswer: I cannot come tomorrow because I have work.

questions.sentence: Tamne paanch vagye fave ke saade paanch?
options: Mane saade paanch vadhare fave che.
Mane tamari sathe malvanu game che.
Mane te jagya ni khabar nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane saade paanch vadhare fave che.
questions.translatedSentence: Half past five suits me better.

questions.sentence: Jo varsad pade to aapne pachhi nakki karishu.
options: If it rains, we will decide later.
If it rains, we will meet anyway.
When it rained, we decided later.
questions.correctAnswer: If it rains, we will decide later.

questions.sentence: Aapne saanje Sabarmati riverfront par maliye?
options: Ha, pan hu thodo modo pahonchis.
Ha, mane aa nadi bahu game che.
Na, hu tya gai kaale gayo hato.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, pan hu thodo modo pahonchis.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but I will get there a little late.

questions.sentence: Mane maaf karjo, mane aavta ma modu thai gayu.
options: I am sorry, I got late on the way here.
I am sorry, I cannot come here at all.
Excuse me, are you going to be late?
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry, I got late on the way here.

questions.sentence: Tu kaale mari sathe undhiyu khava avish?
options: Ha, pan mane saanje saat pachhi j favshe.
Ha, me gai kaale j undhiyu khadhu hatu.
Na, mane undhiyu banavta nathi avadtu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, pan mane saanje saat pachhi j favshe.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but only after seven in the evening will work for me.

questions.sentence: Aapne shukravare maliye to saru, kem ke shanivare hu Vadodara jais.
options: It would be better if we met on Friday, because on Saturday I am going to Vadodara.
It would be better if we met on Saturday, because on Friday I am going to Vadodara.
We met on Friday because I was going to Vadodara on Saturday.
questions.correctAnswer: It would be better if we met on Friday, because on Saturday I am going to Vadodara.

questions.sentence: To aapne guruvare saade chaar vagye nakki rakhie?
options: Ha, nakki rahyu, hu samay sar pahonchi jais.
Ha, mane guruvar ni tarikh khabar nathi.
Na, me haju sudhi kai vichar karyo nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, nakki rahyu, hu samay sar pahonchi jais.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, that is settled, I will get there on time.
